decisions.reason: F1 attributed a strong retraction to a statement promising only finite CW homotopy type. The supplier actually proves the required strong deformation retraction in Proof 1.1 (radial disk-bundle homotopy fixing the exterior) and finite triangulation in Proof 2.2. Explicitly citing these constructions repairs the nonfatal attribution gap. Normalized inverse lifts are equivariant, finite free cellular chains and Noetherian kernels prove finite presentation, and rational specialization plus generic H0 and Euler characteristic prove knot torsion.

The nonprincipality caveat is false: Burde–Zieschang section 9.18 supplies a square presentation of the absolute total-linking module for every link. Corrected the caveat and recorded that source in F3. The gcd definition, knot evaluation and both D normalizations remain valid, so the defect is nonfatal. Checked zero/unit ideals and all five direct consumers; none uses nonprincipality.

Restored the omitted inverse in F(g_i)=g_(i-1)x_i x_(i+1)x_i^(-1). The original intermediate equality is false; F1 and the subsequent partial-product expression already supply the correct bridge, making this a nonfatal transcription defect. Checked the coordinate change, Fox determinant and normalizations against Morton’s complete proof and Conway Theorem 3.15. The statement is unchanged.

A2 mixed an undefined relative edge basis e_i with the supplier’s level-zero classes epsilon_i. Replaced it by h1=[epsilon1-epsilon2], b1=t h1, and cited the proposition’s explicit scalar (-t)^m. This repairs a nonfatal citation/basis mismatch; the scalar and determinant formula were already supplied correctly. Checked negative powers, unit-equivalent mirror value, odd/even component counts, and the Hopf and m=0 zero polynomial cases. Example and consumer statements are unchanged.
